beats.say: This is how they did it.
To understand Tunnel 29, you need to understand this street.

visual.credit: Bundesarchiv, Bild 183-33809-0001 / Hans-Günter Quaschinsky / CC BY-SA 3.0

beats.say: Before 1961, Bernauer Straße was just a street. The sign on it said: you are entering the French sector.
The pavement was West Berlin. The houses along it were East Berlin.
So when the Wall went up in August 1961, people simply jumped. Out of their windows, into the West.
beats.sub: People *jumped* out of their windows, into the West

beats.say: Within weeks, the doors were nailed shut. Then the windows were bricked up.
Whole buildings were emptied.
And the street became a border.
